tasks.title: Email to English teacher about survey priorities
tasks.instruction:
You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Hill, and the notes you have made.

Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

promptBlocks.subject: Fair-trade shopping survey
paragraphs: As you know, our class is helping to plan a fair-trade shopping survey. We want to find out what people in our town think about buying fair-trade products.
First, should the survey focus on why people buy fair-trade items, or on why they don't? Which do you think is more important and why?
Also, we need to choose one place to give out the survey. Would you prefer to do it at the local supermarket or at the weekend market?
Finally, can you suggest one way to encourage more people to complete the survey?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which focus you prefer (reasons for buying OR reasons for not buying) and explain why.
Choose a place to give out the survey (supermarket or market) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to increase the number of completed surveys.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the deadline for the survey.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about fair-trade shopping
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

You see this notice on a specialist magazine website.

Write your article.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Fair-trade shopping – does it make a difference?
Do you think buying fair-trade products helps people in other countries? What is the most important reason to choose fair-trade items?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

tasks.title: Story about a fair-trade discovery
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.

Your story must begin with this sentence:

"When the programme coordinator opened the box of fair-trade chocolate, a small note fell out."

Write your story.

promptBlocks.text: When the programme coordinator opened the box of fair-trade chocolate, a small note fell out.
